needscope.reading: Amul, Nandini, Dodla and Arokya crowd Belonging and Security — cooperative trust, regional pride and dependable purity, so those poles are over-owned. Milky Mist stretches toward Discernment with premium indulgence. Heritage sits on the warm, affiliative edge of Freedom (Orange), free to own an open, energising, self-affirming purity — with clear whitespace to bridge into Power by making purity the source of real strength.

cb: Bought as a dependable daily staple — habit and availability, not active preference.
Consumed at chai-time and breakfast; rarely the hero of any health or strength occasion.
Under-represented in premium value-added baskets (protein curd, fortified milk) and younger households.
db: Actively chosen as the milk that fuels the family — study, sport, growth, active mornings.
Trade-up within franchise: standard milk to fortified and high-protein value-added variants.
Earned share of voice among young parents and fitness-minded consumers as the purity-to-strength brand.
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: It's clean, fresh milk that I trust for my family — reliable and pure, but honestly one good dairy is much like another.
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: Heritage is pure milk that actually makes my family stronger — the goodness I can feel, not just believe.
da_declarative: Purity is active proof of strength.
The everyday milk that builds better days.
cb_ca_db_da.caption: Keep Heritage's warm, trusted purity intact and layer a single new thread on top — that this purity is what gives the family real strength, never replacing trust with a claim.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From assumed dependable purity to purity that visibly gives strength.

draft.smp: Heritage: the pure milk that makes families stronger every day.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Owns belonging and taste-of-India ubiquity but frames milk as wholesome habit, not as the purity that actively builds strength.
Claims regional trust and value but has no equity in strength-through-purity — it defends affordability, not transformation.
Owns health-and-freshness reliability but stops at reassurance; it promises safe milk, not milk that makes you stronger.
Stands for premium indulgence and texture, not everyday accessible strength — its story is craft, not family vigour.
A value-quality staple with no ownable purity-to-strength narrative; it competes on price-reliability, not on building families.

smp_unlocks.brand_line: Pure strength, poured every day. (illustrative — not final copy)
smp_unlocks.mass_line: Shuddhata mein hai asli shakti. (illustrative — not final copy)
smp_unlocks.activation: 'Strength of Purity' school and grassroots-sport programme fuelling young athletes and students with fortified Heritage milk, dramatising visible strength from pure milk.
smp_unlocks.product: Heritage Strength range — high-protein and fortified milk and curd variants that productise the purity-to-strength promise across the franchise.
